Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin scuba crepe molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the single wide strap with its gold stripe and crest and the long bare line of her right shoulder and arm, a smooth pebbled crepe texture and fine stretch lines. Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.

Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: a concert stage at night in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic silver studio microphone on a stand with a round pop filter, giant stacked speaker cabinets with glowing blue lights, giant spotlight beams cutting through haze, softly blurred crowd lights far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall leaning back against the giant microphone stand with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the stage spotlights and the glow of the speakers with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous microphone, speaker cabinets and spotlights around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
